title: Local unit representatives for abelian inverse images in independent universes
statement: Let X,Y be topological spaces in Type u, f:X→Y continuous, and F an Ab.{max u v}-valued sheaf on Y. Use the constructed inverse image f⁻¹F [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and its adjunction unit η. For every open U⊆X, s∈(f⁻¹F)(U), and x∈U, there exist an open V⊆Y containing f(x), t∈F(V), and an open W⊆U∩f⁻¹(V) containing x such that s|W=η(t)|W.

source.place: Tag 008H (inverse-image stalks), and Tag 0A32, lemma-compute-pullback-to-limit, local representability in the surjectivity paragraph.

proof.text: Pushforward of the skyscraper sheaf at x is definitionally the skyscraper sheaf at f(x). Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the fiber of F at f(x) with the fiber of the constructed pullback at x. The unit identity for this uniqueness isomorphism gives its formula on germs.

Apply the inverse fiber isomorphism to the germ of s and represent this element by a section t on a neighborhood V of f(x). The unit formula says the pullback unit image of t and s have equal germs at x.

Restrict to U∩f⁻¹(V). Equality in the filtered neighborhood colimit gives a smaller neighborhood W on which the sections agree. All colimits of fibers are small in u, while their abelian values may lie in max u v.

mathlib_searches.query: Every section of a topological inverse image sheaf of abelian groups is locally a restriction of a unit section
mathlib_searches.results: Ringed-space unit germs and generic global sections results, no inverse-image local representation theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk of the inverse image of an abelian sheaf at x is canonically the stalk at f x, with no equality of coefficient and space universes required
mathlib_searches.results: Presheaf.stalkPullbackIso and its germ formulas concern presheaf pullback. They do not identify local representatives of the constructed sheaf pullback in these universes.
Point.sheafFiberComapIso is the generic abstract stalk comparison; local section extraction and the constructed-unit formula still require proof.

from.place: General cohomological continuity used after constructing the punctured inverse system: sections on quasi-compact opens are represented and identified at a finite stage.

theorem abelianPullback_localSections
    {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : Y.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max u v})
    (U : Opens X)
    (s : ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Opens.map f)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).obj F).obj.obj (op U))
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : Opens Y) (_ : f x ∈ V) (t : F.obj.obj (op V))
      (W : Opens X) (_ : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ (Opens.map f).obj V),
      ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Opens.map f)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).obj F).obj.map (homOfLE hWU).op s =
        ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback (Opens.map f)
          AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).obj F).obj.map (homOfLE hWV).op
              (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                (Opens.map f) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
                  (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).unit.app F).hom.app (op V) t)
